name: codgo-gestao-academica
description: Gestão acadêmica com assistente de IA — desafio Codgo.X

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend --if-present
